findings.source_en: <Bold>Sester Genessa</> is no more and becomes <Bold>Stray</> by default
findings.ar: لم تعد <Bold>الأُخَيّة جينيسا</> موجودة، فتصير <Bold>ضالة</> افتراضيًا.
findings.issue: Stray is frozen through Genessa's family: her title Wayward = الشارِدة, 'Stray Doubles' = القرناء الشاردون, and the NPC-name row ST_Core_NpcNames/StraySester renders 'Stray Genessa' as جينيسا الشاردة. This skill tree calls the same character جينيسا الضالة, so the skill screen and the nameplate name her differently — and الضالة ('the erring/lost one') carries a moral judgement the English does not. Note the same file gets it right for the Doubles (القرناء الشاردون) and for Melee/Ranged Stray Doubles.
findings.suggested_ar: لم تعد <Bold>الأُخَيّة جينيسا</> موجودة، فتصير <Bold>شاردة</> افتراضيًا.

findings.issue: 'Damage Reduction' is تقليل الضرر everywhere else in the build (ID_Support_DamageReductionDesc, TarstoneEffect_DamageReduction, TarstoneEffect_Support_OnKill_Protection). خفض الضرر is a third wording for the same stat.
Word order is broken by the tag placement — 'لدى جينيسا ضد الركود مناعة' does not parse as Arabic. The parallel Eredrim row gets it right: 'لدى إردريم مناعة ضد <Frost>الصقيع</>'.
